command_line:
python - '$accession' sequence.fasta <<'PY'
import json, re, sys, urllib.request
with open(sys.argv[1]) as handle:
    acc = handle.read().strip()
with urllib.request.urlopen("https://rnacentral.org/api/v1/rna/" + acc) as response:
    record = json.load(response)
seq = record["sequence"].upper().replace("T", "U")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[ACGUN]+", seq):
    raise SystemExit("Unexpected RNAcentral sequence")
with open(sys.argv[2], "w") as out:
    out.write(">" + acc + "\n" + seq + "\n")
PY
RNAfold --noPS sequence.fasta > result.txt
